title: Ballet Manila, Steps Dance Studio team up for ‘The Nutcracker’
summary: Ballet Manila and Steps Dance Studio will stage the Christmas classic “The Nutcracker” at the Samsung Performing Arts Theater for the first time, with performances scheduled for December 11-13.
